task:
A fund holds 3852 credits. Its first grant is 11% of that original balance. Return 41% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 6% of the original balance minus 6 credits (the 6 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 12%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 5 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 22 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 18 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 13 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 24 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 21 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 4 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 26 credits, then discount the whole amount by 9%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 8% surcharge, then subtract 6 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 18 credits, then discount the whole amount by 13%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 21 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 12% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 3 credits, then discount the whole amount by 10%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 19% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 12 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 4 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 13%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
